title: 第318章 应该是进入怪谈规则了第317章 怎么会如此热闹
slug: 无敌镖人开局护送灭世帝女
lines: 这应该是一种映射内心的幻境。
燕乐乐显然是看到了她内心最深处的恐惧。
而颜宝儿，则看到了她心心向往的那种安宁生活。
至于他自己……这幻境似乎窥探不到他的内心深处，又或是他的境界太高，幻境无法完全显化，只能映照出一片虚无的空旷大海。
但奇怪的是，他没有感觉到任何的规则之力。
也就是说，他们并未进入怪谈规则，而是陷入了某种幻境。
颜宝儿探出脑袋，小声问。
“陈大哥，我看到的是一片小镇，我们这是不是被拉入怪谈规则了？”
陈观看向怀里的小丫头，问道：“乐乐，你看到了什么？”
“我……”小丫头刚吐出一个字，又将脑袋埋了回去。
“行了，不想说就不用说。”
小丫头点了点头。
这可把颜宝儿急得够呛，这不是吊自己胃口吗？
她只好转头问陈观：“你看到了什么？”
“大海。”陈观淡淡道。
“啊？”颜宝儿心中一惊，“这么诡异的吗？”
“不愧是怪谈规则啊！”
陈观继续打量着眼前一望无际的大海，听不到任何海浪，甚至也看不到一丝波光，就是一片死海。
收回目光后，他看向颜宝儿，随后抬手一指点出。
【死脑筋】！
这个词条能强行锁死自身逻辑思维，无视一切幻境、迷障、精神魅惑和规则引诱。
然而颜宝儿却一把拍开他的手：“干嘛呀你？”
陈观皱了皱眉。
词条失效了？
他赶紧问道：“你看到什么？”
颜宝儿一脸不耐烦道：“还是小镇子啊，我们要不要去看看？”
陈观觉得有些不妙，他再次抬起手指，点在自己额头。
【死脑筋】！
随后抬眼看向前方，依旧是一片无边无际的大海。
完犊子了，这应该是进入怪谈规则了。
在死脑筋这个词条不管用下，那就只能是怪谈规则了。
能让他这位真正的天人都分辨不出是幻境还是规则，可想而知这个怪谈规则的厉害之处。
content_en:
This should be a fantasy that reflects the heart.
Yan Lele obviously saw the deepest fear in her heart.
Yan Baoer, on the other hand, saw the kind of peaceful life she longed for.
As for himself... this illusion seems to be unable to peer into the depths of his heart, or perhaps his realm is too high, and the illusion cannot be fully manifested, and can only reflect an empty sea of ​​nothingness.
But the strange thing is that he didn't feel any power of rules.
In other words, they did not enter the rules of ghost stories, but fell into some kind of illusion.
Yan Baoer stuck his head out and asked softly.
"Brother Chen, what I see is a small town. Are we being dragged into the rules of ghost stories?"
Chen Guan looked at the little girl in his arms and asked, "Lele, what did you see?"
"I..." The little girl just uttered one word and buried her head back.
"Okay, if you don't want to say it, you don't have to say it."
The little girl nodded.
This makes Yan Bao'er very anxious. Doesn't this make him want to eat?
She had no choice but to turn around and ask Chen Guan: "What did you see?"
"The sea." Chen Guan said calmly.
"Ah?" Yan Baoer was shocked, "Is it so weird?"
"It's indeed a strange rule!"
Chen Guan continued to look at the endless sea in front of him. He could not hear any waves or even see a trace of light. It was just a dead sea.
After retracting his gaze, he looked at Yan Baoer, then raised his hand and pointed out.
【Dead brain】!
This entry can forcibly lock one's logical thinking, ignoring all illusions, confusions, mental charms and rule temptations.
However, Yan Baoer slapped his hand away: "What are you doing?"
Chen Guan frowned.
The entry is invalid?
He quickly asked: "What did you see?"
Yan Baoer said impatiently: "It's still a small town, should we go and have a look?"
Chen Guan felt something was wrong. He raised his finger again and touched his forehead.
【Dead brain】!
Then he raised his eyes and looked ahead, still seeing the boundless sea.
It's over, this should be the time to enter the rules of ghost stories.
If the term "dead brain" doesn't work, then it can only be a strange rule.
It makes him, a true heavenly being, unable to tell whether it is an illusion or a rule. One can imagine the power of this strange rule.
